specifications.name: pergola-hero
specifications.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: website hero background for Slovenian shading installer Senčila Volk; conceptual architectural illustration.
Primary request: a polished photorealistic editorial architectural photograph of an attractive, normal contemporary Slovenian detached home, with a clean anthracite bioclimatic aluminium pergola over a comfortable terrace.
Scene/backdrop: green lawn, mature trees and restrained natural landscaping beside a modern white home; realistic Central European residential setting, tasteful but not ostentatious.
Subject: a structurally credible anthracite aluminium pergola, perfectly straight supporting posts and beams, physically coherent narrow louvred roof slats, subtle realistic shadows, comfortable terrace furniture.
Composition/framing: wide 16:9 landscape photograph. The pergola and home occupy the right half. The left half is shaded garden texture with calm dark foliage and open space suitable for a large white headline overlay. The pergola structure must remain clearly readable with coherent perspective. Natural architectural camera at human eye level.
Lighting/mood: beautiful natural late afternoon light, subtle Adriatic warmth, rich but restrained editorial realism.
Color palette: charcoal aluminium, white architecture, green garden, restrained warm natural accents.
Constraints: exactly one photographic image; no people, no lettering, no logos, no watermark. No extreme luxury mansion, no fantastical or distorted architecture, no bent beams, no slats intersecting supporting beams. Do not place any text in image.

specifications.name: zip-screen-detail
specifications.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: architectural product detail photograph for the website of a Slovenian shading installer; conceptual illustration.
Primary request: a polished photorealistic close architectural photograph of exterior zip screen blinds installed on a contemporary white detached house.
Scene/backdrop: a clean white rendered wall, wide floor-to-ceiling glazing and subtle garden greenery in a realistic Central European home.
Subject: exterior zip screen roller blinds with dark anthracite vertical aluminium side guides, a discreet top cassette and taut graphite translucent fabric partially lowered over floor-to-ceiling glazing. The horizontal bottom rail is perfectly straight and the fabric edges sit neatly inside the vertical guides. The woven screen fabric itself is the unmistakable focal point, translucent enough to suggest glazing behind it, with the lower portion of the glass unobstructed.
Style/medium: high-end editorial architectural photography with realistic material texture and physically coherent perspective.
Composition/framing: landscape 4:3 image, close three-quarter architectural view showing the screen blind mechanism, straight aluminium guides and fabric clearly; little visual clutter.
Lighting/mood: natural daylight, subtle garden reflections on glazing, restrained contrast.
Constraints: exactly one photographic image. No people, no text, no logos, no watermark. Exclude roller shutters, metal shutter strips and all venetian blind slats: this must be a single continuous taut textile zip screen surface. No distorted rails or fabric.
